text_block_list.text:
To take on the race by drawing out all of Still in Love's power—even her "instinct."
That direction was decided, but...
"Instinct cannot be controlled... There is no established method. The only way to find a path forward is to try everything."
Seeking battle with the strong—one of the triggers for awakening that instinct—match races were incorporated into the daily routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today!
That was a great run, it really inspired me too!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Likewise...
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer...
I failed again today."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Such a truly contrary child...
choice_data_list: It's okay, let's try again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I wonder why.
They are all such strong runners, just the kind she likes...
choice_data_list: ...Maybe it's because you've gotten stronger.
...Maybe it's because you've gotten stronger.

text_block_list.text: Through her training up to today, she has steadily grown stronger... Ordinary opponents are likely no longer enough for her.
choice_data_list: What I need is... a rival who stirs my instincts.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

At the same moment Still in Love's eyes widened,
she—appeared.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: (That girl is... Admire Groove!)

text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove. Having debuted at the same time
as Still in Love, she stood out in many ways.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"There she is, the 'prodigy' Admire Groove!
That's her, right? Showing incredible talent from a young age, the superstar full of expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I saw your debut race!
Your conditioning was incredible, just as the rumors said...
You're definitely the most watched prospect of this generation!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Stop it.
I can't concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Trainers A & B
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry...!
choice_data_list: (Could it be... if it's her, maybe—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You too.
You're staring too much.
choice_data_list: Huh! S-Sorry—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Still-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That stare.
—It's irritating."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I am truly sorry...
However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Still!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please wait...!
Please, wait...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Wait!
That's my... preeeeyyyy...!!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You... look like the most exquisite feast!
Hey, hey... won't you give me that dazzling light of yours?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: G       I       V       E       M       E       !       !

Still in Love's suddenly awakened instincts
turned toward Admire Groove—
choice_data_list: Still!!!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...!
...You're not even worth talking to.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
...Aw, man.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I was so close to having it!
Still... that was top-tier... Heheheh...♪
choice_data_list: ...It's only natural to run from someone who's out of control.
...It's only natural to run from someone who's out of control.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Scaaary.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: (It came back...!)

text_block_list.text: "It seems she's found a rival who stimulates her instincts. But at this rate... Still in Love will undoubtedly run completely wild during the actual race."
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should try facing the instinct-driven side of her too...)

text_block_list.text:
I felt my words reach her just now.
Which means I can communicate with her instincts, too—
choice_data_list: (Nothing ventured, nothing gained. Luckily, tonight...)

text_block_list.text: "So far, we know of two triggers that draw out her instincts. One is... competing against the strong. The other is—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —A full moon.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Into the primordial blood coursing through me...
pours the pleasant, ancient light...――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It feels good, doesn't it?
—Say, darling...
choice_data_list: (...It's "her.")

text_block_list.text:
I called Still in Love out into the night, and when I arrived at the track... she was already there.
Almost as if... she had been eagerly waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You wish to know, do you not?
You want to uncover every single bit... of me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you...
My...—my fated one.

Nearly swallowed by the bizarre atmosphere,
a question suddenly comes to mind. It's a hazy memory, but...
someone called me their "fated person" before, too.
choice_data_list: Hey... What exactly do you mean by 'destiny'—
Hey. What do you mean, fate—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —All life is beast at its core.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"To defeat the opponent. To be better than anyone else...
Everyone harbors a beast within them called fighting spirit."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
With "Still in Love,"
that remains most... distinctly.
choice_data_list: (Is that... the "mad blood"...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am not virtuous and pure.
I am a beast, nobler than any other.
choice_data_list: That's why... you seek battles with the strong.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Something utterly exquisite
that will truly satisfy me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —And yet, that girl ran away.
choice_data_list: …You mean Admire Groove?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Names do not matter.
If the soul is the same, one will know.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I want to be fulfilled.
Hey, will you show me...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Without letting seasonal prey escape... patiently...
How do I savor it at its absolute most delicious?"

Her eyes flash fiercely for a split second...
As alarm bells slowly begin to ring in my head,
I rack my brain—now is the chance.
choice_data_list: Then... listen to what I have to say.
Then... listen to what I have to say.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...
Why?
choice_data_list: At this rate, you will starve.
At this rate, you will starve.

text_block_list.text:
If she keeps running wildly out of control, no one will be able to truly
compete with her—no rival will emerge.
If they truly seek a clash at the peak of their abilities—
choice_data_list: We have to run a fair and proper "race."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: And so, I should obey you?
choice_data_list: ...You want to feel even more fulfilled, don't you?
...You want to feel even more fulfilled, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"And yet...
What if... I'm not satisfied?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You go first.
The next day.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!
choice_data_list: Still, now!
Still, now's the time!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes...!
—...Please... awaken...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! 
Aah... so today—it's YOU!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *pant*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: ...Feeling calmer now?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Um, more importantly...!
choice_data_list: Instinct... Managed to draw it out nicely!
Instinct... We managed to draw it out nicely, didn't we!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's still... not quite perfect, but...
choice_data_list: Even so, it's a big step forward.
Even so, it's a big step forward!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
It's all thanks to you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: It's all because you worked so hard for us.
It's because you did your best for me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: N-No way...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However... with this, I've finally taken the first step.
Onto the starting line for the Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —It's futile.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Alv-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sharing in each other's joy. Praising one another.
...That becomes our strength, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am different. Love...
—means nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To people so naive...
I can't hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara
belongs to me.
